text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D after steep losses locked in those losses; I should avoid reacting to price declines alone and review the reasons for holding them.","My account can still swing noticeably while I make no trades, so I should monitor the overall risk and diversification rather than assume inaction is safe.","With retirement savings to support my living expenses, I should make gradual, deliberate decisions and avoid trying to predict short-term price movements."]}
